五、阅读理解。  
答题要求 :

请根据文章内容判断句子的正误。

14(15) 
Read the text and decide the following statements are true (T) or false (F).
Tania is a personal shopper. She works with lots of different people. They ask her to buy something and she goes out to the shops and finds it. “Some people ask me to buy birthday or Christmas presents.”
Jake is a TV researcher. His job is to find new ideas for TV programmes. He surfs the internet and looks for stories. But he also travels around the country talking to people. “I love my job. Every story I research is like a new world.”
Debbie is a dog walker. She helps busy people look after their dogs. She takes them for walks, washes them and gives them food when their owners are away. “I love dogs and I like helping people. It’s a perfect job.”

1、(3.00分)

Tania spends hours in shopping centres.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
2、(3.00分)

Debbie travels a lot.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
3、(3.00分)

Jake uses a computer.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
4、(3.00分)

Tania finds things at good prices.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
5、(3.00分)

Debbie and Tania help busy people.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
15(15) 
Read the text and decide the following statements are true (T) or false (F).
Jade's morning
I wake up at about 6:45. I get up and go for a run. Then I have a shower and get dressed. I have a quick breakfast and then I brush my teeth. I leave the house at 8 am. I walk to work. I get to the office at about 8:15. On Saturday and Sunday I get up at about 10:30 and have a long, slow breakfast.
Tim's morning
I wake up at about 10:30 and I have a cup of coffee with my mum. I have a shower, get dressed and I go to my friend's house. We study together, listen to music and play his computer games. At 1 o'clock we get the bus to the university. Our classes start at 2:30.
Cassie's morning
I get up at about 7:30. I make breakfast for Jade and her dad. We have breakfast at about 7:45. Then I have a shower, brush my teeth and get dressed. I work at home. I start work at about  8:30. At about 10 o'clock I leave the house to do some shopping. When I get home I have a cup of coffee with Tim and read the newspaper.

1、(3.00分)

Tim gets up early.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
2、(3.00分)

Tim goes to university in the afternoon.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
3、(3.00分)

Cassie makes breakfast for her family. 

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
4、(3.00分)

Cassie goes shopping in the afternoon.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
5、(3.00分)

Jade walks to work.

  • A) 正确
  • B) 错误
